rows.en: Rider!! Hongo, you're back?
Rider!! Hayato, you're back?

Taki…

Let's save the joy of our reunion for later. Right now, I have to go! I'm counting on you here!
Go…? Where are you going?
To the Cape Tsumeki lighthouse in Izu. We asked him to.
All right, I'm coming with you! I'll hear the details later…
I'm counting on you both!
In this case?
Please take it…
Got it…
Well then…
The true identity of Gel-Shocker's Great Leader is in here!?
Stop it, Taki! All we need to do is deliver it.

No, but…

…!?
Eee!

Gel-Shocker Combatants! Why? How did they find this place?

Rider, take care of the case!
Right, leave it to me!
They're late… They should be back by now…

………

Oh, I know! Have another cup of coffee.
Thank you…
Taki! What took you so long?
Sorry… Gel-Shocker attacked us, and it held me up a bit…

Gel-Shocker?

Then… what about the data?

It's fine! The Rider has the case…

Come to think of it… the Rider isn't back yet either? That's weird. That can't be…

Right… Looks like it went well.

Now all that's left is to deal with this case!
Wait!
What is it? Hiru-Chameleon?

Take Gel-Shocker's fake case to the Anti-Shocker League!

We'll run the real data through Gel-Shocker's computer, analyze it, and then destroy it.
What's inside the fake case?
A killer sound wave.
A killer sound wave?
If they run it through their computer without knowing, the Anti-Shocker League… will be wiped out to the last man!
Fufufu… All right, understood.
At this rate… all our efforts will come to nothing.
Taki, you're safe?
Rider! Where have you been all this time? I was worried!
Kamen Rider! Where is the data?
Right here, safe and sound!
Oh, that's the Rider for you! So now we can find out who the Great Leader really is?
Yes…

Wait!

That case is a fake! The real one is right here!

Wait!

That case is a fake! The real one is right here!
What!?
And you are?
The Anti-Shocker League in Europe chose me as their courier!
The Anti-Shocker League in South America chose me as their courier!
Hongo!
Takeshi!
Ichimonji!
Hayato!
Mr. Kogure, here…
Mr. Kogure, here…
I'll hold on to that…
Rider, since when have you worn that scarf?
Rider, since when have you worn that scarf?
Now that you mention it…
Don't tell me you're…!?
Damn…
Wait!
You caught on a little too late! Hongo, thanks for being our courier all that way. Shocker Rider will be taking this!
You caught on a little too late! Ichimonji, thanks for being our courier all that way. Shocker Rider will be taking this!
Shocker Rider! I won't just hand that over to you!
Shocker Rider! I won't just hand that over to you!
Farewell!

Whoa…

Rider, what's wrong? Why the rush?

Whoa…

Rider, what's wrong? Why the rush?
[HERO2]! That guy's a fake!!
[HERO2]! That guy's a fake!!
A fake? You mean… Kamen Rider?
A fake? Wawawa… Huh? What? Kamen Rider?
We finally had Kamen Riders 1 and 2 together again, and now this happens…
That case holds the grudges of hundreds, thousands of people.
Please avenge my mother, who was killed by Shocker!
Hongo, Hayato, let's storm the enemy's hideout!
Yeah, of course!

Hold on…

You guys aren't the only ones in the Amigo Squad, you know?

Please wait…

The Riders aren't the only ones in the Amigo Squad, you know?
